traps.name: Crumbling Ruin
traps.trigger: Anyone who fails an attribute check with a natural '1' on the die whilst exploring the ruin dislodges something

detection.detail: The structures that support the building look weak and dust regularly filters down from them. The whole ruin groans alarmingly with the wind, punctuated by the sounds of small stones falling from the ceiling.

traps.description: Portions of the ruin are still standing, if only just. Large portions of the stonework have clearly fallen away, time and weather having worn them down.
